description: “The mountains matter, and that’s why I’m running to be the Republican candidate for State Representative in the 94th district. My family has called Eastern Kentucky home for more than 200 years, but unless we correct the course we are on, there will not be much of a community left for the next generation. With your help, I will fight for our future.”

title: Mitch Addison Whitaker for State Representative — The Mountains Matter
